references.text: Refers to the same materials used in the tabernacle, including red skins (tachash skins) that were used as a covering.
Describes the use of tachash skins as a covering over the tabernacle, the same material mentioned in Numbers 4:8.
Refers to the carrying poles for the ark, which are also mentioned here in connection with the table of showbread.
Describes the table of showbread and its carrying poles that must be put in place when it is transported.
Mentions scarlet fabric (tola'at shani) as one of the materials used in the sanctuary.
A parallel text describing a similar procedure with tachash skins and carrying poles for the ark of the covenant.
The same chapter that describes similar coverings with tachash skins for the golden altar and other holy objects.
